title: REQ · BootScene has a single sceneObjects field and keeps its behavior
summary: Only one `private sceneObjects` declaration remains in BootScene
description: Context: L22 and L23 of BootScene.ts both declare `private sceneObjects: SceneObject[] = [];`. Desired behavior: the second declaration (L23) is removed. Expected result: one field, no duplicate member error, sync behavior unchanged. Why: a duplicate class member is a compile error.
acceptance_criteria: Given BootScene.ts, when declarations matching `private sceneObjects:` are counted, then the count is 1.
Given the removal, when the existing bootSceneSync tests run, then they pass unchanged.
